capabilities: Map whole folders of geotagged photos at the places they were taken
Draw GPX, GeoJSON, KML, and TCX routes and areas with elevation profiles and statistics
Build Around views showing the current note's links, backlinks, tracks, and photos
Search and reverse-geocode places via OpenStreetMap or Amap
Use on-disk tile packs as offline basemaps and import or export placemarks as GPX, KML, or CSV
disambiguation: Not a standalone map plugin; it has no map view of its own and its features are skipped without Obsidian's built-in Maps view.
extras: Requires Obsidian 1.13.1 or newer with Bases enabled and the Maps plugin installed; the manifest notes it has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Detailed usage lives in a user guide within the repository.
intentEvidence: It adds to the Maps view Obsidian already ships, and does not replace it
problem: Obsidian's built-in Maps view cannot draw paths, map photos by their embedded location, geocode places, or work offline.

relations.evidence: Map View is the other map plugin for Obsidian, and it is a whole GIS
